title: Organizational System Dynamics - Low-Entropy Design Methodology
boundary_note: Extracts organizational engineering insights from historical system analysis, fully depoliticized for external communication. Dual-track operation: internal comprehensive / external sanitized.
falsifiability: If organizations implementing these principles show no improvement in stability metrics compared to conventional management, the framework's utility is disproven.
humility_clause: These mappings are interpretive frameworks within MSS protective belt, not historical claims. Alternative interpretations exist and should be considered.
